company_name: Shenzhen Han’s Assembly & Testing Technology Company Limited
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor assembly and packaging equipment, particularly in wire bonding and die bonding technologies.
summary: Shenzhen Han’s Assembly & Testing Technology Co., Ltd. (HAN’S ATT) is a national Hi-Tech enterprise focused on the R&D, manufacture, and sales of semiconductor assembly and packaging equipment. They offer high-speed, fully automatic IC wire bonders, die-bonding systems, and SMD sorting machines, recognized for their advanced technology and reliability in the semiconductor market.
capabilities: High-speed fully automatic IC wire bonder
Die-bonding and wire-bonding inline production line

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen and leverages resources from Han’s Laser for R&D and manufacturing.
